viewing_check: Pick up one flower medallion: look for 925, STERLING, a maker mark or issuer name on the rim or reverse, and weigh one on scales (sterling at that diameter would feel heavy, roughly 20-30 g) and try a magnet. Photograph the reverse and edge of one. The rest is low value.
